sanskrit: hā amba tejane dheno lambanastani | na tad vido yad icchasi yad u vittaṃ na tad ghasaḥ ||
english: Alas, O mother, O sharpening-stone, O cow with hanging udder — you do not know what you desire; and what is wealth, that you do not consume.

sanskrit: putro yas te pṛśnibāhus tam u tvaṃ sāmanaṃ kṛdhi | atho duhitaraṃ naptrīm atho tvaṃ sāmanā bhava ||
english: The son who is yours, the spotted-armed one — him do thou render propitious; and also the granddaughter, the daughter's daughter; and do thou thyself become propitious.

sanskrit: asāme kurame naigūrasya svasaḥ | arāte nirṛte amate snuhite ||
english: O Asāmā, O Kuramā, O sister of the harsh one — O Arāti, O Nirṛti, O Amati, O Snuhitā.

sanskrit: pareta kastupakaṃ vaḥ punar dadāmi | yo vo na veda taṃ hata tasyātta pariśiśnyam ||
english: Begone — the evil odor I give back to you; him who does not know you, him strike; eat away his very organ.

sanskrit: tasyātta putrān bhrātṝṃś ca tasya goṣṭhaṃ vitāvata | yaś ca sato nāstivākī yaś cāsāv ahavirgṛhaḥ | durṇāmnīs tatra gacchata tatra sarvāḥ paretana ||
english: Consume his sons and brothers, tear asunder his cattle-stall; and he who is the nay-sayer among the living, and yon whose house lacks oblation — ill-named ones, go thither; depart, all of you, thither.

sanskrit: pari dhāmānīty ekā ||
english: "Around the abodes" — this is one verse.

sanskrit: antaścarāṃ kośecarām atho goṣṭhāvacāriṇīm | atho yāḥ svapne paśyāmas tā ito nāśayāmasi ||
english: Her who roams within, who roams in the granary, and her who prowls about the cattle-stall — and those whom we behold in dreams — them from here we drive away.

sanskrit: kaṇvā yā gardabhīva nibhasat sūkarīva | tasyai pratipravartaya taptam aśmānam āsani ||
english: She who, the blind one, brays like a she-ass and grunts like a sow — against her roll back the red-hot stone into her mouth.

sanskrit: yo maryā abhigacchāt striyaṃ kastupastopinīm | kastupam asyā ācchidya- -athaināṃ cātayātai paramāṃ cit parāvatam ||
english: The young man who should approach a woman reeking of evil odor — cutting off the foul smell from her, then drive her away to the farthest distance.

sanskrit: yā bhadrā yā śivā yorjā payasā saha | agniṣ ṭā asmākaṃ gṛhe gārhapatyo ni yacchatu ||
english: Those who are auspicious, those who are beneficent — both strength and milk together — may Agni Gārhapatya confine them in our house.

sanskrit: idaṃ vo devaḥ savitā- -idaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ | idaṃ vo viśve devā avasānam ayukṣata ||
english: This for you has god Savitā ordained — this god Bṛhaspati; this final resting-place the Viśve Devāḥ have fixed for you.

sanskrit: pari prāgād devo agnī rakṣohāmīvacātanaḥ | sedhan viśvā apa dviṣo dahan rakṣāṃsi viśvahā ||
english: The god Agni has gone round about, the disperser of Rakṣases and afflictions; checking all enemies, burning the Rakṣases forever.

sanskrit: parīme gām aneṣata pary agnim ahṛṣata | deveṣv akrata śravaḥ ka imām̐ ā dadharṣati ||
english: They have led the cow around; they have circled around the fire; they have established glory among the gods — who shall dare to assail these?

sanskrit: tvayīndriyaṃ tvayi varcas tvaṃ dharmapatir bhava | tvam uttaro bhrātṛvyebhyas tava lakṣmīḥ payasvatī ||
english: In thee is virile power, in thee is radiant splendor; become thou the lord of sacred order. Be thou superior to thy rivals; thy prosperity is rich in milk.

sanskrit: tavaitām aśvinā havaṃ tava rāṣṭraṃ divi śritam | tvam āyuṣmān sapatnahā- -uttaro dviṣato bhava ||
english: The Aśvins have established this invocation as yours; your sovereignty is founded in heaven. Be thou long-lived, a slayer of rivals — be thou superior to those who hate thee.

sanskrit: tīkṣṇaśṛṅga ṛṣabhaḥ samudra ivākṣitodakaḥ | tvaṃ sahasravīryas tava bāhū gavāṃ patī ||
english: Like a sharp-horned bull, like the ocean with inexhaustible waters — thou art of a thousand powers; thy two arms are lords of cattle.

sanskrit: bhrātṛvyaś ca sapatnaś ca yas tvāmitro jighāṃsati | śriyaṃ tvaṃ sarveṣāṃ teṣām ādāyogro vi dhāraya ||
english: The rival, the co-adversary, whoever as an enemy would strike thee down — taking away the prosperity of all of them, do thou, O fierce one, hold it wide apart.

sanskrit: tvaṃ vaśī satyākūtaḥ satyadharmā gaveṣaṇaḥ | nāṣṭrās tvaṃ sarvās tīrtvā bhrātṛvyāṇāṃ śriyaṃ vṛha ||
english: Thou art the self-controlled, of true resolve, of true ordinance, the seeker of cattle. Traversing all the paths without loss, strip away the prosperity of thy rivals.

sanskrit: tubhyaṃ saṃ yantu balayas tubhyaṃ śulkaḥ pra vīyatām | tubhyaṃ virāṭ payo duhāṃ tvāṃ vāñchantu viśo mahīḥ ||
english: May tribute-offerings converge upon thee; may the prize be lavished upon thee. May Virāj, the divine sovereign, yield milk for thee; may the great peoples desire thee.

sanskrit: vāñchatu tvā bṛhad rāṣṭraṃ tviṣis te mukha āhitā | tvaṃ devānāṃ bhava priyas tvayi gāvo adhiśritāḥ ||
english: May the great sovereignty long for thee; thy brilliance has been placed in thy face. Be thou dear to the gods; in thee may the cattle be established.

sanskrit: tvayīndriyaṃ tvayi varcas tvayi yajño adhiśritaḥ | tavā yantu havaṃ devās tvaṃ priyo bṛhaspateḥ ||
english: In thee is virile power, in thee is splendor, in thee the sacrifice is established. May the gods come to thy invocation; be thou dear to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit: agnīṣomā pavamānau virāḍ devī payasvatī | atandraṃ sarve rakṣantu rāṣṭraṃ te napavādyam ||
english: Agni and Soma, the purifying ones, and the goddess Virāj, rich in milk — may they all tirelessly guard thy sovereignty, free from reproach.

sanskrit: agnir iva tṛṇaṃ pra daha- -oghaḥ kūlam ivā ruja | śriyaṃ bhrātṛvyāṇām ā datsva- -āṇḍīkam ivādhi puṣkarāt ||
english: As fire burns up the grass, as a flood breaks a river-bank — seize for thyself the prosperity of the rivals, as one plucks a cocoon from a lotus.

sanskrit: aśva iva ratham ā datsva siṃha iva puruṣaṃ hara | hastīva naḍvalān bhaṅdhi bhrātṛvyāṇāṃ śriyaṃ vṛha ||
english: Seize the chariot as a horse does; carry off the man as a lion does; break through the reed-beds as an elephant does — strip away the prosperity of the rivals.

sanskrit: ut te kṛṇotu kaśyapo brahma devair abhiṣṭutam | āprītam avirādhukam ||
english: May Kaśyapa raise up for thee the sacred formulation praised by the gods — fully pleasing, without obstacle.

sanskrit: etaṃ khadiram ā hara- -atho tejanam ā hara | utaitaṃ parṇam ā hara- -ā harānaḍuho balam ||
english: Bring hither this khadira-wood; and bring hither the fire-stick; bring also this palāśa-leaf; bring hither the strength of the draft-ox.

sanskrit: idhmān devaiḥ samābhṛtāṃs tāṃs te prādād bṛhaspatiḥ | tān ā dhehi samāhite 'gnau sūryābhicakṣaṇe ||
english: The fire-sticks gathered together by the gods — those Bṛhaspati has given to thee. Place them on the fire that is well kindled, visible to the sun.

sanskrit: tebhiṣ ṭvam uttaro bhava bhrātṛvyāṇāṃ śriyaṃ vṛha | atho eṣāṃ payo hara ||
english: By these be thou superior; strip away the prosperity of the rivals; and also take away their milk-yield.

sanskrit: ādityā rudrā vasava ṛṣayo bhūtakṛtaś ca ye | śriyaṃ ca kṣatram ojaś ca tubhyaṃ devā asāviṣuḥ ||
english: The Ādityas, the Rudras, the Vasus, the seers, and those who are the makers of beings — prosperity and sovereign power and strength the gods have pressed out for thee.

sanskrit: vasur asīndranāmā- -āyuṣmāñ chataśāradaḥ | sa indra iva deveṣu tviṣīmān viśa ā vada ||
english: Thou art Vasu, named Indra, long-lived for a hundred autumns. Like Indra among the gods, brilliant with fiery splendor, speak unto the peoples.
